units.source_text: 在京都，经常举行诸如鹿谷安乐寺的“供奉南瓜”，或莲华寺的“封印黄瓜” [2] 等仪式。

en.t: In Kyoto, ceremonies are often held, such as Anraku-ji Temple in Shishigatani's pumpkin memorial service, or Renge-ji Temple's cucumber-sealing rite [2].

units.source_text: 这些仪式显示了古都的风貌，也反映了京都人生活的一个方面。

en.t: These ceremonies reveal the character of the old capital, and also reflect one aspect of the lives of Kyoto's people.
